pages.text: Available woods are oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, crimson and warped; bamboo is excluded.$(br2)Boxes, driver’s seats, wheels, stools and cabinets have wood variants. Different parts may use different woods. Conversion and recovery preserve each part’s material.

Upholstered cushions, cargo covers and canopies support all sixteen wool colours. Multiple wool blocks in a recipe must match.$(br2)Materials that determine wood must use supported vanilla species. Auxiliary ingredients marked “any planks” may be modded. Oak and white recipe examples are illustrative, not the only choices.
